run_tabular_q_evaluation: run tabular Q-learning evaluation on the LLVM instcount leaderboard using the CompilerGym environment
train_q_table: train a Q-table policy on a forked LlvmEnv using the Autophase observation space
rollout_trained_policy: execute a rollout of the trained Q-table policy on the LLVM environment without printing output
eval_llvm_instcount_policy: evaluate a tabular Q-learning policy against the LLVM instcount leaderboard benchmark
fork_llvm_env: fork an LlvmEnv instance to create an isolated training environment for Q-learning
